name: SMS User
description: Provides integration between the SMS Framework and Drupal users.
project_description: Submodule of SMS Framework (2.4.x / v2). Integrates SMS with Drupal users: 'active hours' delays automated outgoing messages until a per-site allowed time window; and optional account registration creates a user account from an inbound SMS (either for any unrecognised sender number, or by matching a configurable [username]/[email]/[password] pattern in the message body). Settings at /admin/config/smsframework/user (permission 'administer smsframework'). Depends on smsframework:sms and drupal:user.
